project.name: Demo
project.description: Seeded by the NoLag quickstart. Safe to delete.

accessScopes.name: Acme
accessScopes.description: A tenant. Actors bound to a scope only ever see topics under it, which is how one deployment serves many customers without them being able to reach each other.

accessScopes.name: Globex
accessScopes.description: A second tenant, so that isolation is something you can watch rather than something you take on trust.

apps.name: Chat
apps.description: Open access: every active actor in the project reaches this app without a stored grant.

rooms.name: VIP
rooms.description: Carrying any type grant makes a room private to the types named, even inside an open app.

apps.name: Ops
apps.description: Restricted access: reaching this app requires an explicit grant on the actor.
